description: A plate of segmented shell, scuffed from digging. Dunedelver sheds them the way a road sheds gravel.
lore: There are still legs on it. Six or eight little dry stubs around the rim, snapped short, because a [[monsters/dune_digger|Dunedelver]] comes out of this the way a man comes out of a coat and walks off out of the leg cases as it goes. That is the whole difference between this and the rest of a bag: nothing had to be broken for it. The animal is out there right now, one size bigger, and its old back is in your hand.

The trade finds that unsettling and cannot defend the feeling. A bag of teeth is a bag of endings and no one flinches at it. A carapace is a thing somebody outgrew, lying in the sand looking exactly like a leaving without being one, and there are buyers who will handle them all day and buyers who will not have them in with the rest.
gm_notes: The one junk item that is evidence of nothing bad having happened, and the trade is bothered by it anyway. Handy for showing a new player what the rest of the bag means without saying it.
